description: A paragliding tandem pilot is responsible for taking one student/client at a time on an assisted paragliding flight in a controlled and evaluated environment. They plan and prepare for the flight and are responsible for flyingalong with the student/client while ensuring their safety.
typeOfQualification: General, Upskilling, For ToT, For ToA, Fresh Skilling

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Maintain Safe, Healthy and Hygienic Practices
Follow Gender and Age Sensitive Practices
Prepare for the Flight as a Paragliding Tandem Pilot
Conduct the Flight as a Paragliding Tandem Pilot
Conduct Post Flight Closure and Debrief as a Paragliding Tandem Pilot
Assess and Mitigate Risks for Paragliding Tandem Flight

eligibilityCriteriaGrid.REMARKS: a) Advanced First- Aid/CPR course b) 100 flying hours as a Non-Commercial Pilot on 5 different sites and 5 different paragliders c) Paragliding Association of India P5 Rating Level or Association of Paragliding Pilots and Instructors (APPI) 5 rating or similar rated course

eligibilityCriteriaGrid.PREVNSQFLEVELSACHIEVED: Previous relevant Qualification of NSQF Level 4
